HOW IT WORKS

How Shepherd decides

A frame transaction carries a VERIFY frame and a call. Shepherd’s account approves the call only when the signer, the target, the selector, and the value all fit the session.

1
You are the owner path

Empty VERIFY data means the frame signer is the owner. That path does not read the policy, so it can deploy, stake, grant, and revoke while the account is unstaked.

DOCUMENTATION

How to use Shepherd

You need a browser wallet, or a WalletConnect project id, and a network path to the public devnet. No API key is required for the injected path.

In the console
Open the console and use Connect wallet. Any EIP-6963 wallet can appear. WalletConnect needs VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID. Export/import the frame signer from Wallet → Backup.

PRIVACY

What Shepherd claims
Censorship resistance

The agent path reads another contract during VERIFY. Canonical rules reject that read. A staked account on the alt mempool can be admitted. There is no private relay in front of this.

Open source

MIT. No tracker, no analytics script, no font CDN. The pages in this app are the docs.
